decisions.choice: given rest from all their enemies all around: the promise of rest kept
decisions.reason: Moses promised that the LORD would give Israel rest from all the enemies around them once they had crossed the Jordan (Deuteronomy 12:10; 25:19), and the book has already said that this came true (21:44). Rest here means safety and freedom from war, not that every enemy was gone, since verses 4-5 and 12-13 speak of nations still living in the land.

decisions.choice: old, advanced in days: very old, near the end of his life
decisions.reason: "Coming into the days" is a set way of saying that someone has lived many years, as at 13:1, where the LORD speaks to Joshua in the same words. Joshua repeats them of himself in verse 2, and he dies at the age of 110 (24:29).

decisions.choice: many days after: an unstated length of time after the land was divided
decisions.reason: The verse only sets the time; the main statement, that Joshua called Israel together, comes in verse 2. "Many days" gives no number of years. The place of this gathering is not named, unlike the gathering at Shechem in 24:1.

decisions.choice: old and well along in years
decisions.reason: As at 13:1, Balanced says "well along in years" for the Hebrew "coming into the days".

decisions.choice: A long time passed. ... had given Israel rest ...
decisions.reason: Readable makes the time setting into short sentences of its own, so that verse 2 can begin a new sentence. It keeps "rest", as in 21:44 and 22:4, where the same promise is said to be kept.

decisions.choice: velho, avançado em dias (L); velho e de idade avançada (B); tinha ficado velho (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "coming into the days" (m2) is "avançado em dias" at Literal, keeping the picture; Balanced says "de idade avançada", the ordinary Portuguese for it, as the English says "well along in years" (r-en-1); the same in verse 2.

decisions.choice: elders, heads, judges and officials: the leaders who spoke and acted for the people
decisions.reason: The elders were the senior men of the tribes and towns; the heads were the chiefs of tribes and families; the judges heard cases (Deuteronomy 16:18); and the officials kept records and carried out orders (1:10; 8:33). The same four groups are named again at the second gathering in 24:1.

decisions.choice: all Israel, its elders ...: the whole people, gathered through its leaders
decisions.reason: The list of leaders explains "all Israel": Joshua calls the nation together, and its leaders stand for it. The word "its" points back to Israel as one people.

decisions.choice: I have grown old: the opening of a farewell speech
decisions.reason: Joshua begins as Moses began his last words to Israel, by speaking of his age (Deuteronomy 31:2). What follows is his charge to the people before his death (verse 14), and it uses many words and phrases from Deuteronomy. The speech runs to the end of the chapter.

decisions.choice: leaders
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "heads" means chiefs or leaders; Literal keeps "heads", and Balanced and Readable say "leaders". "Its" becomes "their", since English refers to a people in the plural.

decisions.choice: I am an old man now. I have lived a long life.
decisions.reason: Readable gives the plain sense of "I have come into the days" (m3 and verse 1).

decisions.choice: "jueces" for the judges; "oficiales" for the officials
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets, the judges are "jueces" here, men who settled disputes, before the judges of the next book. The officials were the men who carried out orders among the people; "oficiales" names them without suggesting writing, as "escribas" would.

decisions.choice: Joshua's farewell speeches (chapters 23 and 24) in the tenses of speech, with "vous" to the people
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets: Joshua speaks to all Israel, so "vous"; what has happened is in the passé composé at every level, and the commands in the future at Literal and Balanced ("vous ne ferez pas") and the imperative at Readable ("ne faites pas"), as the Pentateuch note sets for laws and instructions.

decisions.choice: "các quan xét" for the judges at every level
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for the Literal word; here they are officials beside the elders, not the leaders of the book of Judges, so the plain title serves every level.

decisions.choice: Joshua's last speeches (chapters 23 and 24) keep "tôi" and "anh em"
decisions.reason: As he has spoken to the tribes before (18:3; 22:2); an old leader taking leave of his own people.

decisions.choice: Joshua's farewell speech to all Israel in the plain style (해라체), with "나" and "너희"
decisions.reason: As in 18:3 and 22:2, Joshua speaks to the people as their leader. The speech runs from here to verse 16 inside one pair of double quotation marks, as the English does. "재판관" names the judges here, men who decided cases, keeping "사사" for the leaders of the book of Judges.

decisions.choice: vocês (Joshua to Israel, verses 2-16)
decisions.reason: Joshua speaks to the whole people through its leaders, and every Hebrew "you" in the speech is plural, so Portuguese says "vocês" and "o Deus de vocês" at every level, the form people use with each other (1:2); "de vocês" rather than "seu", which could mean "his" or "their". "Os chefes" (L) and "os líderes" (B, R) follow the English (r-en-1); "os oficiais" as 1:10.

decisions.choice: you have seen: you are witnesses yourselves
decisions.reason: The pronoun "you" is written out before the verb, which gives it weight. Joshua speaks to people who saw the LORD's victories with their own eyes, as Moses did at Deuteronomy 11:7.

decisions.choice: because of you: for your sake, on your behalf
decisions.reason: The phrase is literally "from before your faces". It can mean "out of your way" (as in verse 5) or "because of you". Here, with "has done to all these nations", it says why the LORD acted against them: for Israel's sake.

decisions.choice: the one fighting for you: the LORD as Israel's warrior
decisions.reason: Moses told Israel that the LORD would fight for them (Exodus 14:14; Deuteronomy 1:30; 3:22), and the book has said that he did (10:14, 42). The word "he" is stressed: the victories were his, not Israel's. Verse 10 repeats the words.

decisions.choice: himself
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the weight of the written-out "he" with "himself", as at Deuteronomy 3:22.

decisions.choice: to help you; fighting your battles for you
decisions.reason: Readable says the sense of "because of you" (m2) in plain words.

decisions.choice: plural forms through Joshua's farewell speech to all Israel ("ustedes han visto", "su Dios" by default; "vosotros habéis visto", "vuestro Dios" with the plural-you setting)
decisions.reason: Joshua speaks to the whole people, and the Hebrew is plural throughout chapters 23 and 24, so every second-person form takes the plural-you setting. "Su Dios" with the ustedes form becomes "vuestro Dios" with the setting.

decisions.choice: ele [é] o que luta por vocês (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the stressed "he" (m3) and the wording of Deuteronomy 3:22 in Portuguese, "ele [é] o que luta por vocês", which verse 10 repeats.

decisions.choice: Quem tem lutado por vocês é o SENHOR, o Deus de vocês, ele mesmo (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the weight of the stressed pronoun with "ele mesmo", which takes the deity pronoun setting where the English has it on "himself" (r-en-1); "o próprio SENHOR" would put another word inside the divine name span (see 22:23). Putting "Quem tem lutado por vocês" first gives the stress, as the English "It is ... who" does.

source.text: רְאוּ֩ הִפַּ֨לְתִּי לָכֶ֜ם אֶֽת־הַ֠גּוֹיִם הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֛לֶּה בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן וְכָל־הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְרַ֔תִּי וְהַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל מְב֥וֹא הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: See, I have made fall to you the nations the remaining the these as an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, and all the nations that I have cut off, and the sea the great [at the] going in of the sun.

en.L: See, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, as an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, and all the nations that I have cut off, and [to] the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun.
en.B: Look, I have given out to you by lot the land of these nations that remain, as an inheritance for your tribes, together with the land of all the nations I have already destroyed, from the Jordan to the Great Sea in the west.
en.R: Look, I have divided the land among your tribes by lot, so that each tribe has its own share. This includes the land of the nations that are still here, as well as the land of all the nations I have already destroyed. It reaches from the Jordan River in the east to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.

sw.L: Tazameni, nimewagawia mataifa haya yaliyobaki, kuwa urithi kwa makabila yenu, kutoka Yordani, na mataifa yote niliyoyakatilia mbali, [hadi] Bahari Kuu upande wa machweo ya jua.
sw.B: Tazameni, nimewagawia kwa kura nchi ya mataifa haya yaliyobaki, iwe urithi wa makabila yenu, pamoja na nchi ya mataifa yote ambayo nimekwisha kuyaangamiza, kutoka Yordani hadi Bahari Kuu upande wa magharibi.
sw.R: Tazameni, nimeigawa nchi kwa kura kati ya makabila yenu, ili kila kabila liwe na sehemu yake. Hii ni pamoja na nchi ya mataifa ambayo bado yako hapa, na nchi ya mataifa yote ambayo nimekwisha kuyaangamiza. Inaenea kutoka Mto Yordani upande wa mashariki hadi Bahari ya Mediterania upande wa magharibi.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, yo {{plural_you:les|os}} he repartido por suerte estas naciones que quedan, en heredad para {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}}, desde el Jordán, y todas las naciones que he exterminado, y [hasta] el mar Grande, hacia la puesta del sol.
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, yo {{plural_you:les|os}} he repartido por suerte la tierra de estas naciones que quedan, como heredad para {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}}, junto con la tierra de todas las naciones que ya he destruido, desde el Jordán hasta el mar Grande, al occidente.
es.R: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, yo he repartido la tierra entre {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}} por sorteo, para que cada tribu tenga su propia parte. Esto incluye la tierra de las naciones que todavía están aquí, y también la tierra de todas las naciones que ya he destruido. Va desde el río Jordán, en el este, hasta el mar Mediterráneo, en el oeste.

fr.L: Voyez, je vous ai fait échoir par le sort ces nations qui restent, en héritage pour vos tribus, depuis le Jourdain, et toutes les nations que j’ai retranchées, et [jusqu’à] la Grande Mer, au coucher du soleil.
fr.B: Voyez, je vous ai attribué par le sort le pays de ces nations qui restent, en héritage pour vos tribus, ainsi que le pays de toutes les nations que j’ai déjà détruites, depuis le Jourdain jusqu’à la Grande Mer, à l’ouest.
fr.R: Voyez, j’ai partagé le pays entre vos tribus par tirage au sort, pour que chaque tribu ait sa part. Cela comprend le pays des nations qui sont encore là, et aussi celui de toutes les nations que j’ai déjà détruites. Il va du Jourdain, à l’est, jusqu’à la mer Méditerranée, à l’ouest.

vi.L: Hãy xem, tôi đã bắt thăm chia cho anh em các dân tộc còn lại này làm sản nghiệp cho các chi tộc anh em, từ sông Giô-đanh, cùng mọi dân tộc tôi đã diệt trừ, [cho đến] Biển Lớn về phía mặt trời lặn.
vi.B: Hãy xem, tôi đã bắt thăm chia cho anh em đất của các dân tộc còn lại này làm sản nghiệp cho các chi tộc anh em, cùng với đất của mọi dân tộc tôi đã tiêu diệt, từ sông Giô-đanh cho đến Biển Lớn ở phía tây.
vi.R: Hãy xem, tôi đã bắt thăm chia đất cho các chi tộc anh em, để mỗi chi tộc có phần riêng của mình. Trong đó có đất của các dân tộc vẫn còn ở đây, và đất của mọi dân tộc tôi đã tiêu diệt. Đất ấy chạy từ sông Giô-đanh ở phía đông đến Địa Trung Hải ở phía tây.

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 남아 있는 이 민족들을 너희 지파들에게 유산으로 제비 뽑아 나누어 주었다. 요단에서부터, 내가 멸한 모든 민족과, 해 지는 쪽 대해까지이다.
ko.B: 보아라, 나는 아직 남아 있는 이 민족들의 땅과 내가 이미 멸한 모든 민족의 땅을, 요단강에서부터 서쪽 대해까지 제비 뽑아 너희 지파들에게 유산으로 나누어 주었다.
ko.R: 보아라, 나는 제비를 뽑아 그 땅을 너희 지파들에게 나누어 주어, 지파마다 자기 몫을 갖게 하였다. 거기에는 아직 이 땅에 남아 있는 민족들의 땅과 내가 이미 멸한 모든 민족의 땅이 다 들어 있다. 그 땅은 동쪽의 요단강에서부터 서쪽의 지중해까지 이른다.

pt.L: Vejam, eu reparti por sorte para vocês estas nações que restam, como herança para as tribos de vocês, desde o Jordão, e todas as nações que eliminei, e [até] o Grande Mar, do lado do pôr do sol.
pt.B: Vejam, eu reparti entre vocês por sorteio a terra destas nações que restam, como herança para as tribos de vocês, junto com a terra de todas as nações que já destruí, desde o Jordão até o Grande Mar, no oeste.
pt.R: Vejam, eu dividi a terra entre as tribos de vocês por sorteio, para que cada tribo tenha a sua parte. Isso inclui a terra das nações que ainda estão aqui e também a terra de todas as nações que já destruí. Ela vai do rio Jordão, no leste, até o mar Mediterrâneo, no oeste.

decisions.choice: I have allotted to you: I have divided it among you by lot
decisions.reason: The verb means "make fall", that is, cast the lot, as in 13:6, where the LORD told Joshua to allot even the land not yet taken. Joshua did this at Gilgal and Shiloh (chapters 14-19). The nations stand for their land, which each tribe received as its inheritance, a lasting family share.

decisions.choice: from the Jordan ... and the Great Sea: the whole land west of the Jordan, both the part won and the part still held
alternatives: from the Jordan, and all the nations that I have cut off, [even to] the Great Sea
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is compressed: it names the Jordan, then breaks off to add "all the nations that I have cut off", then names the Great Sea without "to". The sense is that the allotted land runs from the Jordan in the east to the sea in the west, and takes in both the nations that remain and those already defeated.

decisions.choice: I have allotted, I have cut off: Joshua speaks of what he did as Israel's leader
decisions.reason: In verse 3 Joshua says that the LORD fought for Israel; here he speaks of the defeat of the nations and the dividing of the land as his own work, because he led Israel in both. The two belong together: the LORD gave the victory, and Joshua carried it out.

decisions.choice: the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun: the Mediterranean, in the west
decisions.reason: "The Great Sea" is the Mediterranean, and "the setting of the sun" means the west, as at 1:4.

decisions.choice: the land of these nations ... the land of all the nations
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "the land of", since what was allotted was the nations' land, not the nations themselves (m1), and they put the two groups of nations together before the boundaries (m2).

decisions.choice: the Jordan River in the east; the Mediterranean Sea in the west
decisions.reason: Readable adds the directions and the modern name of the sea, as at 1:4.

decisions.choice: reparti por sorte (L); reparti ... por sorteio (B); dividi ... por sorteio (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to make the lot fall (m1). Portuguese has no verb for that picture, so Literal says "repartir por sorte" and Balanced and Readable "por sorteio", the everyday word, as the English says "allotted" and "by lot". "O Grande Mar, do lado do pôr do sol" (L) keeps the words of 1:4 in Portuguese (m4).

source.text: וַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם ה֚וּא יֶהְדֳּפֵ֣ם מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם וְהוֹרִ֥ישׁ אֹתָ֖ם מִלִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתֶּם֙ אֶת־אַרְצָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh your God, he will push them from before you and dispossess them from before you, and you will possess their land, just as spoke Yahweh your God to you.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will push them back from before you and dispossess them from your presence, and you will take possession of their land, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God spoke to you.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will push them back ahead of you and drive them out of your way, and you will take possession of their land, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has promised you.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God will push those nations back as you advance. He will force them out of your way, and you will take their land as your own. This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God promised you.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atayasukuma mbele yenu na kuyafukuza mbele yenu, nanyi mtaimiliki nchi yao, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu alivyowaambia.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atayasukuma nyuma mbele yenu na kuyafukuza mtoke njiani mwenu, nanyi mtaimiliki nchi yao, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu alivyowaahidi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu atayasukuma mataifa hayo nyuma mnapoendelea mbele. Atayaondoa njiani mwenu, nanyi mtaichukua nchi yao iwe yenu. Hivyo ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu alivyowaahidi.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} las empujará de delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y las desposeerá de {{plural_you:su presencia|vuestra presencia}}, y {{plural_you:poseerán|poseeréis}} su tierra, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dicho.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} mismo las hará retroceder delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y las expulsará de {{plural_you:su camino|vuestro camino}}, y {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} posesión de su tierra, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha prometido.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} hará retroceder a esas naciones a medida que {{plural_you:ustedes avancen|vosotros avancéis}}. Las obligará a quitarse de {{plural_you:su camino|vuestro camino}}, y {{plural_you:ustedes tomarán|vosotros tomaréis}} su tierra como propia. Esto es lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:les|os}} prometió.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui les repoussera devant vous et les dépossédera de devant vous, et vous posséderez leur pays, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu vous l’a dit.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} les repoussera devant vous et les chassera de votre chemin, et vous prendrez possession de leur pays, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu vous l’a promis.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu repoussera ces nations à mesure que vous avancerez. Il les forcera à quitter votre chemin, et leur pays deviendra le vôtre. C’est ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu vous a promis.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đẩy lui họ khỏi trước mặt anh em và đuổi họ khỏi trước mặt anh em, và anh em sẽ chiếm hữu đất của họ, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đã phán với anh em.
vi.B: Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, sẽ đẩy lui họ trước mặt anh em và đuổi họ đi khỏi đường anh em, và anh em sẽ chiếm hữu đất của họ, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đã hứa với anh em.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, sẽ đẩy lui các dân tộc ấy khi anh em tiến lên. Ngài sẽ buộc họ ra khỏi đường anh em, và anh em sẽ lấy đất của họ làm của mình. Đó là điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đã hứa với anh em.

ko.L: 그리고 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분께서 그들을 너희 앞에서 밀어내시고 너희 앞에서 그들을 쫓아내실 것이다. 그리고 너희는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 말씀하신 대로 그들의 땅을 차지할 것이다.
ko.B: 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 그들을 너희 앞에서 밀어내시고 너희 앞에서 쫓아내실 것이다. 그러면 너희는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 약속하신 대로 그들의 땅을 차지할 것이다.
ko.R: 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희가 나아갈 때 그 민족들을 밀어내실 것이다. 그분께서 그들을 너희 앞에서 몰아내실 것이고, 너희는 그들의 땅을 너희 것으로 차지할 것이다. 이것이 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 약속하신 일이다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os empurrará de diante de vocês e os desapossará de diante de vocês, e vocês tomarão posse da terra deles, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, lhes falou.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, {{deity_pronoun:ele mesmo|Ele mesmo}}, os empurrará para longe de vocês e os expulsará da frente de vocês, e vocês tomarão posse da terra deles, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, lhes prometeu.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, vai empurrar essas nações para trás à medida que vocês avançarem. Ele vai tirá-las do caminho de vocês, e vocês vão tomar a terra delas como sua. Foi isso que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, prometeu a vocês.

decisions.choice: push them back: thrust them away
decisions.reason: The verb means to push or shove someone away. Moses used it of the LORD driving out Israel's enemies (Deuteronomy 6:19; 9:4).

decisions.choice: dispossess ... you will possess: the same verb in two forms
decisions.reason: One form of the verb means to drive a people out of their land; the other means to take possession of that land. The LORD drives out, and Israel takes over what he empties. Deuteronomy pairs the two in the same way (Deuteronomy 9:3; 11:23).

decisions.choice: he will: the land still held by the nations will be taken, but by the LORD
decisions.reason: The pronoun "he" is stressed again, as in verse 3. Joshua is about to die, but the work left undone does not depend on him; the LORD himself will finish it, as he said to Joshua at 13:6. The promise is tied to Israel's faithfulness in verses 6-13.

decisions.choice: as the LORD your God spoke to you: the promises of Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: "Spoke" here means "promised". The LORD had promised through Moses to drive out the nations before Israel (Deuteronomy 9:3; 11:23; 31:3).

decisions.choice: dispossess (Literal) / drive out (Balanced) / force them out (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 13:6: Literal keeps "dispossess" for this verb used of nations; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: desapossará ... tomarão posse (L); expulsará ... tomarão posse (B); tirá-las do caminho ... tomar a terra delas (R)
decisions.reason: The two forms of one verb (m2) keep the Portuguese of Deuteronomy 11:23: "desapossar" at Literal for driving a people from its land, and "expulsar" at Balanced, as the English says "drive out" (r-en-1); "tomar posse" for Israel's taking over at Literal and Balanced. The masculine "os" and "deles" refer to the nations as peoples, as the Hebrew does.

source.text: וַחֲזַקְתֶּ֣ם מְאֹ֔ד לִשְׁמֹ֣ר וְלַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַכָּת֔וּב בְּסֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֥י סוּר־מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃

records.literal_gloss: And be strong very to keep and to do all the written in [the] book of [the] law of Moses, so as not to turn aside from it right or left,

en.L: And be very strong to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, not turning aside from it [to the] right or [to the] left,
en.B: So be very strong, and keep and carry out everything written in the book of the law of Moses, without turning aside from it to the right or to the left,
en.R: So be very strong, and be careful to obey everything written in the book of Moses' teaching. Do not wander away from it in any direction.

sw.L: Basi kuweni hodari sana kushika na kutenda yote yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu cha sheria ya Musa, msigeuke kutoka hiyo [kwenda] kulia wala [kwenda] kushoto,
sw.B: Basi kuweni hodari sana, mshike na kutekeleza kila kitu kilichoandikwa katika kitabu cha sheria ya Musa, bila kugeuka kutoka hiyo kwenda kulia wala kushoto,
sw.R: Basi kuweni hodari sana, na mwe waangalifu kutii kila kitu kilichoandikwa katika kitabu cha mafundisho ya Musa. Msiyaache kwa namna yoyote ile.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}} mucho para guardar y hacer todo lo que está escrito en el libro de la ley de Moisés, sin {{plural_you:apartarse|apartaros}} de ella [ni a la] derecha ni [a la] izquierda,
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:sean|sed}} muy fuertes, y {{plural_you:guarden|guardad}} y {{plural_you:cumplan|cumplid}} todo lo que está escrito en el libro de la ley de Moisés, sin {{plural_you:apartarse|apartaros}} de ella ni a la derecha ni a la izquierda,
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:sean|sed}} muy fuertes, y {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado de obedecer todo lo que está escrito en el libro de la enseñanza de Moisés. No {{plural_you:se aparten|os apartéis}} de ella en ninguna dirección.

fr.L: Et soyez très forts pour garder et pratiquer tout ce qui est écrit dans le livre de la loi de Moïse, sans vous en détourner [ni à] droite ni [à] gauche,
fr.B: Soyez donc très forts pour garder et mettre en pratique tout ce qui est écrit dans le livre de la loi de Moïse, sans vous en écarter ni à droite ni à gauche,
fr.R: Soyez donc très forts, et appliquez-vous à obéir à tout ce qui est écrit dans le livre de l’enseignement de Moïse. Ne vous en éloignez dans aucune direction.

vi.L: Hãy rất mạnh mẽ để giữ và làm theo mọi điều chép trong sách luật pháp Môi-se, không xây [qua] bên phải hay [qua] bên trái,
vi.B: Vậy hãy rất mạnh mẽ, giữ và làm theo mọi điều chép trong sách luật pháp Môi-se, đừng xây qua bên phải hay bên trái,
vi.R: Vậy hãy rất mạnh mẽ, và cẩn thận vâng giữ mọi điều chép trong sách lời dạy của Môi-se. Đừng đi lệch khỏi đó về bất cứ hướng nào.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 아주 굳세어서 모세의 율법책에 기록된 모든 것을 지켜 행하고, 그것에서 오른쪽으로나 왼쪽으로 벗어나지 말아라.
ko.B: 그러니 너희는 아주 굳세어라. 그리고 모세의 율법책에 기록된 것을 모두 지켜 행하고, 그것에서 오른쪽으로도 왼쪽으로도 벗어나지 말아라.
ko.R: 그러니 너희는 아주 굳세어라. 모세의 가르침이 담긴 책에 쓰여 있는 것을 모두 조심하여 지켜라. 어느 쪽으로도 그 말씀에서 벗어나지 말아라.

pt.L: E sejam muito fortes para guardar e para cumprir tudo o que está escrito no livro da lei de Moisés, sem se desviar dele [para a] direita nem [para a] esquerda,
pt.B: Por isso, sejam muito fortes: guardem e cumpram tudo o que está escrito no livro da lei de Moisés, sem se desviar dele nem para a direita nem para a esquerda,
pt.R: Por isso, sejam muito fortes e tenham cuidado de obedecer a tudo o que está escrito no livro do ensino de Moisés. Não se afastem dele em nenhuma direção.

decisions.choice: be very strong to keep and to do ...: the LORD's charge to Joshua, now passed on to the people
decisions.reason: These words repeat what the LORD said to Joshua when he first took command (1:7-8). There the charge was to Joshua alone; now, at the end of his life, Joshua lays the same charge on all Israel.

decisions.choice: and be strong: the call that follows from the promise of verse 5
decisions.reason: The verb form, joined to what comes before by "and", works here as a command. Because the LORD will finish driving out the nations, Israel must hold firm in keeping his law. As at 1:7, the strength asked for is steadiness in obeying, more than courage in battle.

decisions.choice: the book of the law of Moses: the written teaching Moses gave
decisions.reason: "Law" here is the whole of Moses' teaching, as at 1:7-8 and 8:31, and the book is the one Moses wrote and left with the priests (Deuteronomy 31:9, 24-26).

decisions.choice: not turning aside to the right or to the left: keeping to it exactly
decisions.reason: The picture is of a road kept without straying to either side (Deuteronomy 5:32; 28:14; Joshua 1:7).

decisions.choice: Moses' teaching; in any direction
decisions.reason: As at 1:7: Readable says "teaching" for "law" and explains "right or left" as "in any direction". It ends the sentence here; the next verse continues the same thought.

decisions.choice: "le livre de la loi de Moïse" (L, B), "le livre de l'enseignement de Moïse" (R)
decisions.reason: Torah is instruction as well as law. Literal and Balanced keep "loi", lowercase as in the phrase "the book of the law"; Readable says "enseignement", as the English Readable says "teaching".

decisions.choice: sejam muito fortes; a lei (L, B), o ensino (R); nem para a direita nem para a esquerda
decisions.reason: Joshua passes on to the people the charge the LORD gave him (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of 1:7, here in the plural: "sejam muito fortes", "a lei" (L, B) and "o ensino" (R), "não se desviar dele nem para a direita nem para a esquerda" (Readable "em nenhuma direção").

source.text: לְבִלְתִּי־בוֹא֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אִתְּכֶ֑ם וּבְשֵׁ֨ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֤ם לֹא־תַזְכִּ֨ירוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֔יעוּ וְלֹ֣א תַעַבְד֔וּם וְלֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: so as not to go among the nations the these, the remaining the these with you; and the name of their gods not you shall bring to remembrance, and not you shall cause to swear, and not you shall serve them, and not you shall bow down to them.

en.L: so that you do not go in among these nations, these that remain with you. And you shall not make mention of the name of their gods, and you shall not make [anyone] swear [by them], and you shall not serve them, and you shall not bow down to them.
en.B: so that you do not mix with these nations that are left among you. Do not even speak the names of their gods, or make anyone swear by them. Do not serve them or bow down to them.
en.R: Do not mix with the nations that are still living among you. Do not even say the names of their gods, and do not let anyone make a promise in their names. Do not worship those gods or bow down to them.

sw.L: ili msiingie kati ya mataifa haya, haya yaliyobaki pamoja nanyi. Wala msiyataje majina ya miungu yao, wala msiapishe [kwa hiyo], wala msiitumikie, wala msiisujudie.
sw.B: ili msichanganyike na mataifa haya yaliyobaki kati yenu. Msiyataje hata majina ya miungu yao, wala msimwapishe mtu kwa majina hayo. Msiitumikie wala msiisujudie.
sw.R: Msichanganyike na mataifa ambayo bado yanaishi kati yenu. Msiyataje hata majina ya miungu yao, wala msimruhusu mtu yeyote kuapa kwa majina yao. Msiiabudu miungu hiyo wala msiisujudie.

es.L: para que no {{plural_you:se mezclen|os mezcléis}} con estas naciones, estas que quedan con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Y no {{plural_you:mencionarán|mencionaréis}} el nombre de sus dioses, ni {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} jurar [por ellos], ni {{plural_you:los servirán|los serviréis}}, ni {{plural_you:se inclinarán|os inclinaréis}} ante ellos.
es.B: para que no {{plural_you:se mezclen|os mezcléis}} con estas naciones que quedan entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ni siquiera {{plural_you:pronuncien|pronunciéis}} los nombres de sus dioses, ni {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} que nadie jure por ellos. No {{plural_you:los sirvan|los sirváis}} ni {{plural_you:se inclinen|os inclinéis}} ante ellos.
es.R: No {{plural_you:se mezclen|os mezcléis}} con las naciones que todavía viven entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ni siquiera {{plural_you:digan|digáis}} los nombres de sus dioses, y no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que nadie haga una promesa en su nombre. No {{plural_you:adoren|adoréis}} a esos dioses ni {{plural_you:se inclinen|os inclinéis}} ante ellos.

fr.L: pour que vous n’alliez pas parmi ces nations, celles qui restent avec vous. Et vous ne rappellerez pas le nom de leurs dieux, et vous ne ferez pas jurer [par eux], et vous ne les servirez pas, et vous ne vous prosternerez pas devant eux.
fr.B: pour ne pas vous mêler à ces nations qui restent au milieu de vous. Ne prononcez même pas le nom de leurs dieux, et ne faites jurer personne par eux. Ne les servez pas et ne vous prosternez pas devant eux.
fr.R: Ne vous mêlez pas aux nations qui vivent encore au milieu de vous. Ne prononcez même pas le nom de leurs dieux, et ne laissez personne faire une promesse en leur nom. N’adorez pas ces dieux et ne vous prosternez pas devant eux.

vi.L: để anh em không đi vào giữa các dân tộc này, là những dân còn lại với anh em. Anh em không được nhắc đến tên các thần của họ, không được bắt [ai] thề [nhân danh các thần ấy], không được phụng sự chúng, và không được quỳ lạy chúng.
vi.B: để anh em không pha trộn với các dân tộc còn sót lại giữa anh em. Đừng nhắc đến tên các thần của họ, cũng đừng bắt ai thề nhân danh các thần ấy. Đừng phụng sự hay quỳ lạy các thần ấy.
vi.R: Đừng pha trộn với các dân tộc vẫn còn sống giữa anh em. Đừng nói đến cả tên các thần của họ, và đừng để ai nhân danh các thần ấy mà thề hứa. Đừng thờ phượng các thần ấy hay quỳ lạy chúng.

ko.L: 너희와 함께 남아 있는 이 민족들, 이들 가운데로 들어가지 말아라. 그리고 그들의 신들의 이름을 부르지 말고, [누구에게도 그것들로] 맹세하게 하지 말고, 그것들을 섬기지 말고, 그것들에게 절하지 말아라.
ko.B: 너희 가운데 남아 있는 이 민족들과 섞이지 말아라. 그들의 신들의 이름을 입에 올리지도 말고, 그 이름으로 맹세하게 하지도 말아라. 그 신들을 섬기거나 그것들에게 절하지 말아라.
ko.R: 너희 가운데 아직 살고 있는 민족들과 섞이지 말아라. 그들의 신들의 이름을 입에 올리지도 말고, 누구든지 그 신들의 이름으로 약속하게 하지 말아라. 그 신들을 섬기거나 그것들에게 절하지 말아라.

pt.L: para que vocês não entrem no meio destas nações, estas que restam com vocês. E não mencionarão o nome dos deuses delas, e não farão [ninguém] jurar [por eles], e não os servirão, e não se prostrarão diante deles.
pt.B: para que não se misturem com estas nações que ficaram entre vocês. Nem sequer pronunciem o nome dos deuses delas, nem façam ninguém jurar por eles. Não os sirvam nem se prostrem diante deles.
pt.R: Não se misturem com as nações que ainda vivem entre vocês. Nem falem o nome dos deuses delas, e não deixem ninguém fazer promessas em nome deles. Não adorem esses deuses nem se curvem diante deles.

decisions.choice: go in among these nations: mix with them, become close to them
decisions.reason: To "go in among" a people is to enter into close dealings with them and become part of their life. The same words come back in verse 12, along with marriage. The warning is not against meeting them, but against being drawn into their ways and worship.

decisions.choice: do not make mention of the name of their gods: do not call on them or speak of them with honor
decisions.reason: The law of Exodus 23:13 uses the same words: Israel was not to mention the names of other gods or let them be heard from their lips. To speak a god's name in prayer or praise was to give it a place.

decisions.choice: do not make anyone swear by them: do not have oaths taken in their names
decisions.reason: The verb form means to make someone swear or to put someone under oath. To swear by a god was to call on that god as witness and judge; Israel was to swear by the LORD's name alone (Deuteronomy 6:13; 10:20). The phrase may also cover swearing by them oneself.

decisions.choice: serve ... bow down: worship in act and in body
decisions.reason: To serve a god was to worship it with offerings and obedience; to bow down was to fall before it in worship. The two verbs together repeat the second commandment (Exodus 20:5; Deuteronomy 5:9).

decisions.choice: mix with; Do not even speak/say the names
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "mix with" for "go in among" (m1), and add "even" to give the force of the ban on mentioning the gods' names at all.

decisions.choice: make a promise in their names; worship
decisions.reason: Readable explains swearing as making a promise in a god's name, and says "worship" for "serve".

decisions.choice: não mencionarão o nome (L); Nem sequer pronunciem o nome (B); Nem falem o nome (R); servir, prostrar-se (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring a name to mind by speaking it (m2), as in Exodus 23:13; "mencionar" says this at Literal, and Balanced and Readable add "nem sequer" / "nem" for the English "even" (r-en-1). "Servir" and "prostrar-se" keep the words of the commandment (m4), as Deuteronomy 11:16 has them in Portuguese; Readable says "adorem" and "se curvem" (r-en-2).

source.text: כִּ֛י אִם־בַּיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם תִּדְבָּ֑קוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: But to Yahweh your God you shall cling, just as you have done until the day the this.

en.L: But to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God you shall hold fast, just as you have done until this day.
en.B: Instead, hold fast to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, as you have done up to now.
en.R: Instead, stay close to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, as you have done up to now.

sw.L: Bali mtashikamana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, kama mlivyofanya hadi siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: Badala yake, ambataneni na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, kama mlivyofanya mpaka sasa.
sw.R: Badala yake, kaeni karibu na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, kama mlivyofanya mpaka sasa.

es.L: Sino que {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:se aferrarán|os aferraréis}}, tal como {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: En cambio, {{plural_you:aférrense|aferraos}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, como lo {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} hasta ahora.
es.R: En cambio, {{plural_you:manténganse|manteneos}} cerca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, como lo {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} hasta ahora.

fr.L: Mais à {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu vous vous attacherez, comme vous l’avez fait jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: Au contraire, attachez-vous à {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, comme vous l’avez fait jusqu’à présent.
fr.R: Au contraire, restez proches {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, comme vous l’avez fait jusqu’à maintenant.

vi.L: Nhưng anh em phải gắn bó với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, như anh em đã làm cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: Trái lại, hãy gắn bó với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, như anh em đã làm cho đến nay.
vi.R: Trái lại, hãy ở gần bên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, như anh em đã làm cho đến nay.

ko.L: 오직 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 너희는 붙어 있어라. 너희가 오늘까지 해 온 것처럼 하여라.
ko.B: 오히려 지금까지 해 온 것처럼 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 꼭 붙어 있어라.
ko.R: 오히려 지금까지 해 온 것처럼 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 곁을 떠나지 말아라.

pt.L: Mas {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, vocês se apegarão, como fizeram até este dia.
pt.B: Pelo contrário, apeguem-se {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, como fizeram até agora.
pt.R: Em vez disso, fiquem bem perto {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, como fizeram até agora.

decisions.choice: hold fast: cling, stay joined in loyalty
decisions.reason: The verb means to stick to something or someone, and is used of the bond between husband and wife (Genesis 2:24). Moses used it of Israel's loyalty to the LORD (Deuteronomy 4:4; 10:20; 11:22; 13:5). In verse 12 the same verb is used of clinging to the nations, so the two loyalties are set against each other.

decisions.choice: but: instead of all that verse 7 forbids
decisions.reason: The two little words together mean "but rather" after a list of things not to do. Loyalty to the LORD is the one thing that replaces them all.

decisions.choice: as you have done to this day: Joshua's generation has been faithful
decisions.reason: Joshua praises the people for their loyalty so far. The book later says that Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him (24:31; Judges 2:7).

decisions.choice: hold fast (Literal, Balanced) / stay close (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb is rendered as in Deuteronomy 10:20 and 13:5.

decisions.choice: apegar-se a (L, B); ficar bem perto de (R)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 10:20 and 11:22 and Joshua 22:5 in Portuguese: "apegar-se" at Literal and Balanced, the verb of a close and loyal bond (m1), and "ficar bem perto" at Readable (r-en-1). Verse 12 uses the same Portuguese verb for clinging to the nations, as the Hebrew uses the same verb.

source.text: וַיּ֤וֹרֶשׁ יְהוָה֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם גּוֹיִ֖ם גְּדֹלִ֣ים וַעֲצוּמִ֑ים וְאַתֶּ֗ם לֹא־עָ֤מַד אִישׁ֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And has dispossessed Yahweh from before you nations great and mighty; and you, not has stood a man before you until the day the this.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has dispossessed great and mighty nations from before you; and as for you, {{gender:no one|no man}} has stood before you until this day.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has driven out great and powerful nations ahead of you, and to this day {{gender:no one|no man}} has been able to stand against you.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has driven out great and strong nations as you advanced. Up to now, {{gender:no one|no man}} has been able to stand up to you.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefukuza mbele yenu mataifa makubwa na yenye nguvu; nanyi, hakuna mtu aliyesimama mbele yenu hadi siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefukuza mbele yenu mataifa makubwa na yenye nguvu, na mpaka leo hakuna mtu aliyeweza kusimama dhidi yenu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefukuza mataifa makubwa na yenye nguvu mlipokuwa mkisonga mbele. Mpaka sasa hakuna mtu aliyeweza kusimama dhidi yenu.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha desposeído de delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} naciones grandes y poderosas; y en cuanto a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, nadie ha podido {{plural_you:hacerles|haceros}} frente hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha expulsado delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a naciones grandes y poderosas, y hasta el día de hoy nadie ha podido {{plural_you:hacerles|haceros}} frente.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha echado a naciones grandes y fuertes a medida que {{plural_you:ustedes avanzaban|vosotros avanzabais}}. Hasta ahora nadie ha podido {{plural_you:resistirles|resistiros}}.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dépossédé devant vous des nations grandes et puissantes ; et quant à vous, {{gender:personne|aucun homme}} n’a tenu devant vous jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a chassé devant vous des nations grandes et puissantes, et jusqu’à ce jour {{gender:personne|aucun homme}} n’a pu vous résister.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a chassé des nations grandes et fortes à mesure que vous avanciez. Jusqu’à maintenant, {{gender:personne|aucun homme}} n’a pu vous tenir tête.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi những dân tộc lớn và mạnh khỏi trước mặt anh em; còn anh em, cho đến ngày nay không ai đứng nổi trước mặt anh em.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi những dân tộc lớn và hùng mạnh đi trước mặt anh em, và cho đến ngày nay không ai chống cự nổi anh em.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi những dân tộc lớn và mạnh đi khi anh em tiến lên. Cho đến nay, không ai có thể chống cự nổi anh em.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 크고 강한 민족들을 너희 앞에서 쫓아내셨다. 그리고 너희로 말하면, 오늘까지 아무도 너희 앞에 서지 못하였다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 크고 강한 민족들을 너희 앞에서 쫓아내셨으므로, 오늘까지 아무도 너희를 당해 내지 못하였다.
ko.R: 너희가 나아갈 때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 크고 강한 민족들을 쫓아내셨다. 지금까지 아무도 너희에게 맞서지 못하였다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} desapossou de diante de vocês nações grandes e poderosas; e quanto a vocês, ninguém ficou de pé diante de vocês até este dia.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} expulsou da frente de vocês nações grandes e poderosas, e até hoje ninguém conseguiu resistir a vocês.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} expulsou nações grandes e fortes à medida que vocês avançavam. Até agora, ninguém conseguiu enfrentar vocês.

decisions.choice: has dispossessed great and mighty nations: a promise of Deuteronomy, now done
decisions.reason: Moses had said that the LORD would drive out nations greater and mightier than Israel (Deuteronomy 4:38; 9:1; 11:23). Joshua now speaks of it as done.

decisions.choice: no one has stood before you: no enemy has held out against you
decisions.reason: To "stand before" an enemy is to resist him and hold one's ground. The LORD had promised this to Israel and to Joshua (Deuteronomy 7:24; 11:25; Joshua 1:5), and Joshua says the promise has been kept. The word is "man", but the sense is "no one at all".

decisions.choice: and as for you: the words point to Israel's side of the story
decisions.reason: The written-out "you" turns from what the LORD did to what Israel has known: whatever nation they met, none could stand against them.

decisions.choice: No one / No man
decisions.reason: As at 1:5, the default reads "no one" for "a man" used in the sense of "anyone"; the traditional setting keeps "no man".

decisions.choice: no gender span on "hakuna mtu"
decisions.reason: The English offers "no one" or "no man" through the gender setting. Swahili "mtu" already means any person, so there is only one wording and nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "nadie" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts "no one" / "no man" under the gender setting. Spanish "nadie" already takes in everyone and is the natural word for the Hebrew "a man" in this sense, so Spanish has no second wording for the setting.

decisions.choice: "아무도" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts "no one" against "no man" under the gender setting. Korean "아무도" is already inclusive and is what a traditional reader expects as well, so the setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: ninguém, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As 1:5: the Hebrew "man" means anyone (m2), and Portuguese "ninguém" already says that, so there is nothing for the English gender setting to change.

source.text: אִישׁ־אֶחָ֥ד מִכֶּ֖ם יִרְדָּף־אָ֑לֶף כִּ֣י׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם ה֚וּא הַנִּלְחָ֣ם לָכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: One man of you pursues a thousand, for Yahweh your God, he [is] the one fighting for you, just as he spoke to you.

en.L: One man of you pursues a thousand, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the one fighting for you, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to you.
en.B: One of your men can put a thousand to flight, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} fights for you, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised you.
en.R: One of your soldiers can chase away a thousand enemies, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is fighting for you, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised.

sw.L: Mtu mmoja wenu anafukuza elfu, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] anayewapigania, kama alivyowaambia.
sw.B: Mmoja wa watu wenu anaweza kuwakimbiza elfu, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} anawapigania, kama alivyowaahidi.
sw.R: Askari wenu mmoja anaweza kuwafukuza maadui elfu, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu anawapigania, kama alivyoahidi.

es.L: Un solo hombre de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} persigue a mil, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el que pelea por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, tal como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dijo.
es.B: Uno solo de {{plural_you:sus hombres|vuestros hombres}} puede hacer huir a mil, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} mismo pelea por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} lo prometió.
es.R: Uno solo de {{plural_you:sus soldados|vuestros soldados}} puede hacer huir a mil enemigos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} pelea por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, tal como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo prometió.

fr.L: Un seul homme d’entre vous en poursuit mille, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui combat pour vous, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous l’a dit.
fr.B: Un seul de vos hommes peut en mettre mille en fuite, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu combat {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} pour vous, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous l’a promis.
fr.R: Un seul de vos soldats peut faire fuir mille ennemis, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu combat pour vous, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a promis.

vi.L: Một người trong anh em đuổi được một ngàn, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đấng chiến đấu cho anh em, đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với anh em.
vi.B: Một người của anh em có thể đánh đuổi một ngàn người, vì chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, chiến đấu cho anh em, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với anh em.
vi.R: Một chiến sĩ của anh em có thể đuổi chạy một ngàn kẻ thù, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đang chiến đấu cho anh em, đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa.

ko.L: 너희 가운데 한 사람이 천 명을 쫓는다. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분께서 너희에게 말씀하신 대로 너희를 위하여 싸우시는 분이시기 때문이다.
ko.B: 너희 가운데 한 사람이 천 명을 쫓아낼 수 있다. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로 친히 너희를 위하여 싸우시기 때문이다.
ko.R: 너희 군사 한 사람이 원수 천 명을 쫓아낼 수 있다. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로 너희를 위하여 싸우고 계시기 때문이다.

pt.L: Um só homem de vocês persegue mil, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] o que luta por vocês, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes falou.
pt.B: Um só homem de vocês põe mil em fuga, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, {{deity_pronoun:ele mesmo|Ele mesmo}}, luta por vocês, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes prometeu.
pt.R: Um só soldado de vocês consegue fazer mil inimigos fugirem, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, está lutando por vocês, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} prometeu.

decisions.choice: one man pursues a thousand: the promise of victory against great odds
decisions.reason: The law promised that a few of Israel would chase many enemies (Leviticus 26:8; Deuteronomy 28:7). The Song of Moses turns the picture around: if Israel is unfaithful, one enemy will chase a thousand Israelites (Deuteronomy 32:30).

decisions.choice: pursues: what happens whenever Israel fights with the LORD
decisions.reason: The verb form can describe what usually happens or what will happen. Joshua states it as a general truth drawn from the victories they have seen: the numbers do not decide the battle.

decisions.choice: a thousand: a very large number
decisions.reason: The number is not a count of soldiers but a picture of one against many.

decisions.choice: he is the one fighting for you, just as he promised: the words of verse 3 and of Moses
decisions.reason: Joshua repeats the end of verse 3. The promise was given through Moses (Deuteronomy 3:22; 20:4).

decisions.choice: soldiers; enemies
decisions.reason: Readable says who the one and the thousand are: an Israelite fighter and the enemies he chases.

source.text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְנַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֑ם לְאַהֲבָ֖ה אֶת־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And take great care very for your souls to love Yahweh your God.

en.L: And take great care for your souls, to love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: So be very careful, for your own sake, to love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: So be very careful to love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Your own lives depend on it.

sw.L: Basi jihadharini sana kwa ajili ya nafsi zenu, kumpenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.B: Basi jihadharini sana, kwa faida yenu wenyewe, kumpenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.R: Basi kuweni waangalifu sana kumpenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Maisha yenu yanategemea jambo hilo.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} mucho cuidado por {{plural_you:sus almas|vuestras almas}}, de amar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} mucho cuidado, por {{plural_you:su propio bien|vuestro propio bien}}, de amar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} mucho cuidado de amar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. {{plural_you:Sus vidas dependen|Vuestras vidas dependen}} de ello.

fr.L: Et prenez bien garde à vos âmes, pour aimer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.B: Veillez donc avec grand soin, pour votre propre bien, à aimer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.R: Faites donc très attention à aimer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. Votre vie en dépend.

vi.L: Hãy hết sức giữ lấy linh hồn mình, để yêu kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em.
vi.B: Vậy vì chính mình, anh em hãy hết sức cẩn thận yêu kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em.
vi.R: Vậy hãy hết sức cẩn thận yêu kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em. Mạng sống của anh em tùy thuộc vào điều đó.

ko.L: 그리고 너희 목숨을 위하여 매우 조심하여 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 사랑하여라.
ko.B: 그러니 너희 자신을 위하여 아주 조심하여 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 사랑하여라.
ko.R: 그러니 아주 조심하여 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 사랑하여라. 너희 목숨이 거기에 달려 있다.

pt.L: E guardem muito as almas de vocês, para amarem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês.
pt.B: Portanto, tenham muito cuidado, para o próprio bem de vocês, de amar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês.
pt.R: Por isso, tenham muito cuidado de amar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês. A vida de vocês depende disso.

decisions.choice: take great care for your souls: be very careful, because your own life is at stake
decisions.reason: The word often translated "soul" means a person's life or self. To guard oneself "for one's soul" is to take care as one would to save one's life. Moses used the same words at Deuteronomy 4:15. Verses 12-16 show what is at stake: Israel's life in the land.

decisions.choice: to love the LORD your God: the great command of Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: Love for the LORD is the heart of Moses' teaching (Deuteronomy 6:5; 10:12; 11:13, 22). It means loyal devotion shown in obedience, not only feeling.

decisions.choice: Your own lives depend on it.
decisions.reason: Readable says the sense of "for your souls" (m1) as a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: guardem muito as almas de vocês (L); para o próprio bem de vocês (B)
decisions.reason: The words are those of Deuteronomy 4:15 (m1), so Literal and Balanced keep that verse's Portuguese: Literal the Hebrew "almas", Balanced "para o próprio bem de vocês", where the English says "for your own sake".

source.text: כִּ֣י׀אִם־שׁ֣וֹב תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ וּדְבַקְתֶּם֙ בְּיֶ֨תֶר֙ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְהִֽתְחַתַּנְתֶּ֥ם בָּהֶ֛ם וּבָאתֶ֥ם בָּהֶ֖ם וְהֵ֥ם בָּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For if turning you turn back and cling to [the] rest of the nations the these, the remaining the these with you, and intermarry with them, and go in among them and they among you,

en.L: For if you do indeed turn back and cling to the rest of these nations, these that remain with you, and intermarry with them, and go in among them and they among you,
en.B: For if you ever turn away and attach yourselves to what is left of these nations that remain among you, if you intermarry with them and mix with them and they with you,
en.R: Suppose you ever turn away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and join yourselves to the people of the nations still living among you. Suppose your families marry into theirs, and you mix with them and they with you.

sw.L: Kwa maana mkirudi nyuma kweli na kushikamana na mabaki ya mataifa haya, haya yaliyobaki pamoja nanyi, na kuoana nao, na kuingia kwao nao kwenu,
sw.B: Kwa maana mkigeuka kamwe na kujiunga na mabaki ya mataifa haya yaliyobaki kati yenu, mkioana nao na kuchanganyika nao nao wakichanganyika nanyi,
sw.R: Tuseme mtamwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku moja na kujiunga na watu wa mataifa ambayo bado yanaishi kati yenu. Tuseme jamaa zenu wataoana na jamaa zao, nanyi mtachanganyika nao nao wachanganyike nanyi.

es.L: Porque si de veras {{plural_you:se vuelven|os volvéis}} atrás y {{plural_you:se unen|os unís}} al resto de estas naciones, estas que quedan con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:emparentan|emparentáis}} con ellas, y {{plural_you:se mezclan|os mezcláis}} con ellas y ellas con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}},
es.B: Porque si alguna vez {{plural_you:se apartan|os apartáis}} y {{plural_you:se unen|os unís}} a lo que queda de estas naciones que permanecen entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, si {{plural_you:emparentan|emparentáis}} con ellas por matrimonio y {{plural_you:se mezclan|os mezcláis}} con ellas y ellas con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}},
es.R: Supongamos que alguna vez {{plural_you:se apartan|os apartáis}} {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:se unen|os unís}} a la gente de las naciones que todavía viven entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Supongamos que {{plural_you:sus familias|vuestras familias}} se casan con las de ellos, y que {{plural_you:ustedes se mezclan|vosotros os mezcláis}} con ellos y ellos con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Car si vous vous détournez vraiment, et que vous vous attachez au reste de ces nations, celles qui restent avec vous, et que vous vous alliez à elles par mariage, et que vous alliez parmi elles et elles parmi vous,
fr.B: Car si jamais vous vous détournez et que vous vous attachez à ce qui reste de ces nations demeurées au milieu de vous, si vous vous alliez à elles par des mariages et si vous vous mêlez à elles et elles à vous,
fr.R: Supposons qu’un jour vous vous détourniez {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et que vous vous attachiez aux gens des nations qui vivent encore au milieu de vous. Supposons que vos familles se marient avec les leurs, et que vous vous mêliez à eux et eux à vous.

vi.L: Vì nếu anh em quay lưng lại và gắn bó với phần còn lại của các dân tộc này, là những dân còn lại với anh em, và kết thông gia với họ, đi vào giữa họ và họ đi vào giữa anh em,
vi.B: Vì nếu có bao giờ anh em quay lưng và gắn bó với phần còn lại của các dân tộc còn sót giữa anh em, nếu anh em kết thông gia và pha trộn với họ, và họ với anh em,
vi.R: Giả sử có bao giờ anh em quay lưng với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và gắn bó với dân của các dân tộc vẫn còn sống giữa anh em. Giả sử gia đình anh em kết thông gia với họ, và anh em pha trộn với họ, họ với anh em.

ko.L: 너희가 정말로 돌아서서 너희와 함께 남아 있는 이 민족들, 이 남은 자들에게 붙어서, 그들과 혼인하고 너희가 그들 가운데로, 그들이 너희 가운데로 들어가면,
ko.B: 너희가 혹시라도 돌아서서 너희 가운데 남아 있는 이 민족들의 남은 자들과 가까이하여, 그들과 혼인하고 서로 섞이게 되면,
ko.R: 혹시라도 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 떠나, 너희 가운데 아직 살고 있는 민족들과 한편이 된다고 하자. 너희 집안이 그들의 집안과 혼인하고, 너희와 그들이 서로 섞인다고 하자.

pt.L: Pois, se de fato vocês voltarem atrás e se apegarem ao resto destas nações, estas que restam com vocês, e se aparentarem com elas por casamento, e entrarem no meio delas e elas no meio de vocês,
pt.B: Pois, se algum dia vocês se desviarem e se apegarem ao que resta destas nações que ficaram entre vocês, se fizerem casamentos com elas e se misturarem com elas, e elas com vocês,
pt.R: Pode ser que algum dia vocês se afastem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e se juntem aos povos das nações que ainda vivem entre vocês. Pode ser que as famílias de vocês se casem com as famílias deles, e que vocês se misturem com eles, e eles com vocês.

decisions.choice: if you do indeed turn back: a strong statement of the danger
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled in Hebrew, which makes it emphatic: "if you really do turn back". To "turn back" is to turn away from following the LORD (Numbers 14:43; Joshua 22:16).

decisions.choice: cling to: the verb of verse 8, now used of the nations
decisions.reason: Verse 8 told Israel to cling to the LORD. Here the same verb describes clinging to the nations instead. Israel cannot hold fast to both.

decisions.choice: intermarry with them: the ban of Deuteronomy 7:3-4
decisions.reason: The verb means to become related by marriage. Moses forbade marriage with the peoples of Canaan, and gave the reason: they would turn Israel's children away to serve other gods (Deuteronomy 7:3-4). The danger was religious; the book itself tells of Rahab, a woman of Canaan who joined Israel (6:25).

decisions.choice: go in among them and they among you: becoming one people with them
decisions.reason: The phrase of verse 7 is used both ways here: Israel would mix with the nations and the nations with Israel, until there was no difference between them.

decisions.choice: turn away from the LORD

ko.L: 너희는 분명히 알아라. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 민족들을 너희 앞에서 더 이상 쫓아내지 않으실 것이다. 그리고 그들이 너희에게 올무와 덫이 되고, 너희 옆구리의 채찍과 너희 눈의 가시가 되어, 마침내 너희가 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 주신 이 좋은 땅에서 멸망할 것이다.
ko.B: 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 민족들을 너희 앞에서 더 이상 쫓아내지 않으실 것을 분명히 알아라. 그들은 너희에게 올무와 덫이 되고, 너희 옆구리를 치는 채찍과 너희 눈을 찌르는 가시가 되어, 마침내 너희는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 주신 이 좋은 땅에서 사라지고 말 것이다.
ko.R: 그러면 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 민족들을 너희 앞에서 쫓아내시는 일을 그만두실 것이다. 이것을 분명히 알아라. 오히려 그 민족들은 너희를 붙잡는 덫과 같이 될 것이다. 그들은 등을 때리는 채찍처럼, 눈을 찌르는 가시처럼 너희를 괴롭힐 것이다. 마침내 너희는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 주신 이 좋은 땅에서 멸망하여 사라질 것이다.

pt.L: saibam com certeza que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, não continuará a desapossar estas nações de diante de vocês. Elas se tornarão para vocês uma armadilha e um laço, um açoite nos flancos e espinhos nos olhos, até que vocês desapareçam desta boa terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, lhes deu.
pt.R: Então podem ter certeza de que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, vai parar de expulsar estas nações do caminho de vocês. Em vez disso, elas vão ser como uma armadilha que prende vocês. Vão machucar vocês como um chicote nas costas e como espinhos nos olhos. No fim, vocês serão destruídos e vão desaparecer desta boa terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, deu a vocês.

decisions.choice: know for certain: be in no doubt
decisions.reason: The verb "know" is doubled for emphasis, as "turn back" is in verse 12. Joshua warns with full certainty.

decisions.choice: will no longer dispossess these nations: the promise of verse 5 depends on faithfulness
decisions.reason: The LORD's promise to drive out the nations (verse 5) is not unconditional. If Israel clings to the nations, he will stop driving them out. Judges tells how this happened (Judges 2:3, 20-23).

decisions.choice: a trap, a snare, a whip on your sides, thorns in your eyes: the warnings of the law
decisions.reason: The law had warned that the peoples of the land and their gods would be a snare to Israel (Exodus 23:33; Deuteronomy 7:16) and that any left would be like barbs in their eyes and thorns in their sides (Numbers 33:55). Joshua joins the pictures: something that catches you unawares, and something that wounds you again and again. The angel of the LORD repeats the warning at Judges 2:3.

decisions.choice: whip: a lash or scourge
decisions.reason: This word for a whip is found only here in the Hebrew Bible. Its sense is drawn from related words for whipping and from the parallel pictures in Numbers 33:55.

decisions.choice: until you perish from this good land: the threat of Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: Moses had warned that unfaithfulness would make Israel perish from the good land the LORD was giving them (Deuteronomy 4:26; 11:17). "Perish" here means to be destroyed or lost from the land, not only to die one by one.

decisions.choice: like a trap that catches you ... hurt you like a whip ... and like thorns
decisions.reason: Readable makes the pictures into comparisons and says what each one does. It says "back" for "sides" as the place a whip strikes.

decisions.choice: wiped out
decisions.reason: As at Deuteronomy 11:17, Balanced says "wiped out" for "perish" from the land; Literal keeps "perish".

decisions.choice: uma armadilha e um laço; um açoite (L, B), um chicote (R); pereçam (L), desapareçam (B)
decisions.reason: "Laço" is the snare of Deuteronomy 7:16 in Portuguese (m3); "açoite" names the lash of the rare word (m4), and Readable says "chicote", the everyday word. Literal keeps "perecer" and Balanced "desaparecer", the words Deuteronomy 11:17 has in Portuguese for perishing from the land (m5; r-en-2).
